summary:
Second review of w128, after the answer. Reviewed d842f89, the one commit between 'w128 ready -> claimed' and 'claimed -> done'; it is the same change as the reported 15b3801, rebased by the merge, and the branch work/w128 is gone.
Nothing changed under features/ and no test was removed or weakened (93 insertions, 0 deletions). The report's allowances row 'none' holds.
The five r8-r12 scenarios pass. Size: nothing over 300. Check: one ruff and one vulture finding, both in files of w131 and w126, none in w128's commits.
The first review's Important finding (work turn resets a delivered request to accepted) was answered on 2026-10-24: the work-item is accepted as it stands, and r8 and r9 are narrowed by their own fix work-item. It is carried as ruled, not fix now.
Two Minor observations stand: an out-of-range outcome line lets turn settle a line with no outcome; resolve with no --line sets delivered with an empty resolution.
